Merge individual scores

```{r}
library(jsonlite)

exclude_ids <- c("22", "31", "98",'108') # unfinished subject
col_map <- list(
  TLetter = list(stim = "letter",      p1 = "soa1",      p2 = "soa2"),
  TGabor  = list(stim = "orientation", p1 = "soa1",      p2 = "soa2"),
  TPi     = list(stim = "orientation", p1 = "soa1",      p2 = "soa2"),
  SLetter = list(stim = "letter",      p1 = "alpha1",    p2 = "alpha2"),
  SGabor  = list(stim = "orientation", p1 = "contrast1", p2 = "contrast2"),
  SPi     = list(stim = "orientation", p1 = "diff1",     p2 = "diff2")
)
perception_tasks <- names(col_map)
read_perception_task <- function(task) {
  m       <- col_map[[task]]
  folder  <- file.path("Data",task, "Data")
  pattern <- paste0("_", task, "\\.csv$")
  files   <- list.files(folder, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)

  dat_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    tmp <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    id  <- sub(pattern, "", basename(f))
    data.frame(
      id        = id,
      task_name = task,
      session   = tmp$session,
      trial     = tmp$trial,
      staircase = tmp$staircase,
      stimulus  = tmp[[m$stim]],
      response  = tmp$response,
      correct   = tmp$correct,
      param1    = tmp[[m$p1]],
      param2    = tmp[[m$p2]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, dat_list)
}
all_perception_raw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(perception_tasks, read_perception_task))
all_perception_raw <- subset(all_perception_raw, !id %in% exclude_ids)
write.csv(all_perception_raw, "Data/summary/all_perception_raw.csv", row.names = FALSE)

read_span_task <- function(task) {
  folder    <- file.path("Data",task, "Data_summary")
  pattern   <- paste0("_", task, "_summary\\.csv$")
  files     <- list.files(folder, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  score_col <- if (task == "OSpan") "ospan_absolute" else "abs_perfect_sum"

  dat_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    tmp <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    id  <- sub(pattern, "", basename(f))
    data.frame(id = id, task_name = task, score = tmp[[score_col]],
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  do.call(rbind, dat_list)
}
span_scores <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("OSpan","CSpan"), read_span_task))
pid_map  <- read.csv("Data/Matrix/pid.csv",  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
code_map <- read.csv("Data/Matrix/code.csv", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

pick_valid_battery <- function(batteries) {
  n_summary <- sapply(batteries, function(b) length(b$Summary))
  valid_idx <- which(n_summary > 0)
  if (length(valid_idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  batteries[[valid_idx[length(valid_idx)]]]
}

corsi_rows  <- vector("list", nrow(pid_map))
matrix_rows <- vector("list", nrow(pid_map))

for (k in seq_len(nrow(pid_map))) {
  id          <- pid_map$Pid[k]
  server_code <- pid_map$`Server code`[k]
  subject_id  <- paste0("sycm", server_code)
  j   <- match(subject_id, code_map$`Subject ID`)
  uid <- code_map$`Logging Name`[j]

  path <- list.files(file.path("Data", "Matrix"), pattern = paste0("^", uid, ".*\\.json$"),
                    full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  dat <- fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE)

  battery_names <- sapply(dat$data, function(b) b$Battery)
  corsi_idx  <- grep("corsi",       battery_names, ignore.case = TRUE)
  matrix_idx <- grep("wircs|ucmrt", battery_names, ignore.case = TRUE)

  # ---- Corsi ----
  corsi_battery <- pick_valid_battery(dat$data[corsi_idx])
  corsi_score <- NA
  if (!is.null(corsi_battery)) {
    corsi_summary <- corsi_battery$Summary
    summary3      <- corsi_summary[[length(corsi_summary)]]
    corsi_score <- ifelse(
      !is.null(summary3$TotalCorrectResponsesCorrectSpot),
      summary3$TotalCorrectResponsesCorrectSpot,
      summary3$CorrectResponsesCorrectSpot
    )
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("id %s: no matched corsi battery, skipped", id))
  }
  corsi_rows[[k]] <- data.frame(id = as.character(id), task_name = "Corsi", score = corsi_score)

  # ---- Matrix reasoning ----
  matrix_battery <- pick_valid_battery(dat$data[matrix_idx])
  matrix_score <- NA
  if (!is.null(matrix_battery)) {
    matrix_score <- matrix_battery$Summary[[1]]$Hits
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("id %s (uid=%s): no matched matrix battery, skipped", id, uid))
  }
  matrix_rows[[k]] <- data.frame(id = as.character(id), task_name = "Matrix", score = matrix_score)
}
matrix_corsi_scores <- rbind(do.call(rbind, corsi_rows), do.call(rbind, matrix_rows))

all_cognitive_scores <- rbind(span_scores, matrix_corsi_scores)
all_cognitive_scores$id <- as.character(all_cognitive_scores$id)
all_cognitive_scores <- subset(all_cognitive_scores, !id %in% exclude_ids)
write.csv(all_cognitive_scores, "Data/summary/all_cognitive_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

Read 6 perception tasks and 4 cognitive tasks, and compute raw scores
```{r}
perc_df    <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_perception_raw.csv")
cog_scores <- read.csv("Data/summary/all_cognitive_scores.csv")
perc_df$param <- ifelse(perc_df$staircase == 2, perc_df$param1, perc_df$param2)

# perception score = mean stimulus level over the last 150 trials
perc_df <- perc_df[order(perc_df$id, perc_df$task_name, perc_df$session, perc_df$trial, perc_df$staircase), ]
perc_scores <- aggregate(param ~ id + task_name, data = perc_df,
                         FUN = function(x) round(mean(tail(x, 150), na.rm = TRUE), 4), na.action = na.pass)
names(perc_scores)[3] <- "score"

all_scores <- reshape(rbind(perc_scores, cog_scores), idvar = "id", timevar = "task_name", direction = "wide")
names(all_scores) <- sub("^score\\.", "", names(all_scores))
cog_tasks  <- c("OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")
perc_tasks <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi", "SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi")
all_scores[cog_tasks] <- -all_scores[cog_tasks]   # higher = poorer, as for thresholds
all_scores <- all_scores[c("id", perc_tasks, cog_tasks)]
```

Exclude scores more than 4 SD from the task mean (thresholds on the log scale)
```{r}
library(corrplot)
sd_cutoff <- 4
tasks  <- c(perc_tasks, cog_tasks)
zscore <- function(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

all_scores_clean <- all_scores
all_scores_clean[perc_tasks] <- log(all_scores_clean[perc_tasks])
all_scores_clean[tasks] <- lapply(all_scores_clean[tasks], function(x)
  zscore(replace(x, abs(zscore(x)) > sd_cutoff, NA)))

cat("Excluded per task:\n"); print(colSums(is.na(all_scores_clean[tasks])) - colSums(is.na(all_scores[tasks])))

R <- cor(all_scores_clean[tasks], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
corrplot(R, method = "color", addCoef.col = "black", number.cex = 0.6, tl.col = "black")

# ---- summary of mean correlations -------------------------------------------
bwd <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi")
spa <- c("SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi")
lower <- function(M) M[lower.tri(M)]
cat(sprintf("Same-stimulus pairs (B vs S):  %.3f\n", mean(diag(R[bwd, spa]))))
cat(sprintf("Within backward masking:       %.3f\n", mean(lower(R[bwd, bwd]))))
cat(sprintf("Within spatial masking:        %.3f\n", mean(lower(R[spa, spa]))))
cat(sprintf("Perception to cognition:       %.3f\n", mean(R[perc_tasks, cog_tasks])))

write.csv(all_scores,       "Data/summary/all_scores.csv",       row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(all_scores_clean, "Data/summary/all_scores_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ---- hierarchical clustering on the raw correlations ------------------------
lab <- c(TLetter = "Letter", TGabor = "Gabor", TPi = "Pi",
         SLetter = "Letter", SGabor = "Gabor", SPi = "Pi",
         OSpan = "OSPAN", CSpan = "CSPAN", Corsi = "SSPAN", Matrix = "UCMRT")
grp <- c(TLetter = "B", TGabor = "B", TPi = "B", SLetter = "S", SGabor = "S", SPi = "S",
         OSpan = "C", CSpan = "C", Corsi = "C", Matrix = "C")
grp_pch  <- c(B = 15, S = 17, C = 16)
grp_name <- c(B = "Backward masking", S = "Spatial masking", C = "Cognitive task")
n <- length(tasks)

hc   <- hclust(as.dist(1 - R), method = "average")
dend <- reorder(as.dendrogram(hc), wts = seq_len(n), agglo.FUN = mean)   # masking tasks to the left
leaves <- tasks[order.dendrogram(dend)]
y_lo <- floor((min(hc$height) - 0.05) * 10) / 10
y_hi <- max(hc$height) + 0.20                                             # headroom for the legend

par(mar = c(3.2, 4.5, 1, 1), xpd = FALSE, yaxs = "i")
plot(dend, leaflab = "none", ylim = c(y_lo, y_hi), yaxt = "n", edgePar = list(lwd = 1.4))
axis(2, at = seq(y_lo, max(hc$height) + 0.06, by = 0.10), las = 1, cex.axis = 0.75, tcl = -0.3)
mtext("Distance", side = 2, line = 3, cex = 0.85)
par(xpd = NA)
points(seq_len(n), rep(y_lo, n), pch = grp_pch[grp[leaves]], cex = 1.3)
text(seq_len(n), y_lo - 0.045, lab[leaves], cex = 0.8)
legend(x = 0.5, y = y_hi, xjust = 0, yjust = 1, legend = grp_name, pch = grp_pch,
       bty = "n", cex = 0.8, pt.cex = 1.1)
par(xpd = FALSE)
```
